baslik: Flopnik: Why America's Answer to Sputnik Failed Twice

sahneler.metin: This is America's answer to Sputnik, breaking apart for the second time.
The first try, just two months earlier, rose only four feet and exploded.
So what went wrong on the pad?
Fuel pressure was too low, so fire leaked back through the injector.
This second rocket flew, but its control system failed at 57 seconds.
A month later, the next Vanguard reached orbit.
It's still up there, the oldest satellite in space.

aciklama:
On December 6, 1957, Vanguard TV3 rose four feet and exploded on the pad; the backup broke up in flight in February 1958. The third attempt put Vanguard 1 in orbit, where it remains today.
